name: x402
description: Open payment protocol reviving HTTP 402, now governed by the Linux Foundation.
descriptionZh: 复活 HTTP 402 的开放支付协议，现由 Linux Foundation 治理。
keyFact: x402 revives the HTTP 402 status code to let agents pay per request in stablecoins or cards; created by Coinbase, it moved to vendor-neutral governance when the Linux Foundation announced the x402 Foundation's operational launch on 14 July 2026 with 40 members including AWS, Google, Visa, Mastercard and Stripe.
keyFactZh: x402 复活 HTTP 402 状态码，让 Agent 可用稳定币或银行卡按请求付费；它由 Coinbase 创建，后转入厂商中立治理——Linux Foundation 于 2026 年 7 月 14 日宣布 x402 Foundation 正式运营，成员达 40 家，包括 AWS、Google、Visa、Mastercard 与 Stripe。
caveat: Foundation dates vary by source: an intent was announced around April 2026, while the operational launch was 14 July 2026.
caveatZh: 基金会时间点来源不一：约 2026 年 4 月宣布成立意向，2026 年 7 月 14 日为首日正式运营。
